description: This file defines a console command class GenerateDoctrineProxiesCommand used to generate Doctrine ORM proxy classes within the OrangeHRM system. It incorporates configurations, interacts with Doctrine ORM's EntityManager, and outputs the number of proxies generated.

classes.name: GenerateDoctrineProxiesCommand
classes.description: A console command class for generating Doctrine ORM proxy classes, extending the base Command class.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the console command 'orm:generate-proxies'.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command to generate Doctrine proxy classes by configuring ORM, connecting to an in-memory SQLite database, and reporting the number of proxies created.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Collects and returns an array of entity paths from plugin directories based on configuration.
